title: Contrast Adjustment
text: Adjust image contrast using linear scaling, 1 input, 1 output, {Adjust pixel values from} sets Input pixel value range definition Full input data range [min; {Range [low high]} sets the input pixel value range, {Percentage of pixels to saturate [low high]} sets the maximum percentages of pixels to saturate, {Specify number of histogram bins (used to calculate the range when outliers are eliminated)} sets the custom number of histogram bins, {Number of histogram bins}, {Adjust pixel values to} sets the output pixel value range definition Full data type and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Adjust pixel values from
params.values: Input pixel value range definition Full input data range [min max] (default) | User-defined range | Range determined by saturating outlier pixels

params.name: Range [low high]
params.values: Input pixel value range [0 255] (default) | two-element vector of nonnegative numbers

params.name: Percentage of pixels to saturate [low high]
params.values: Maximum percentages of pixels to saturate [1 1] (default) | two-element vector of nonnegative numbers

params.name: Specify number of histogram bins (used to calculate the range when outliers are eliminated)
params.values: Custom number of histogram bins on (default) | off

params.name: Number of histogram bins
params.values: Number of histogram bins 256 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Adjust pixel values to
params.values: Output pixel value range definition Full data type range (default) | User-defined range

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
